parts.text: (ii) The student pours away the water from beaker A. He then places beaker A inside beaker B so that there is an air gap between the two beakers, as shown in Fig. 2.3. parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) Calculate the average cooling rate R for beaker A cooling on its own. Use the readings for beaker A in Table 2.1 and the equation R = θ 0 – θ 180 T where T = 180 s and θ 0 and θ 180 are the temperatures of the water in beaker A at t = 0 and t = 180 s.
